ALTER PROC [d360].[SP_hash_log_LNS] AS
BEGIN
-------------------------LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(float,COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(float,ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD)),0) ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
